answer_1.quote: We aim to train LMs to follow human instructions (e.g., answering open-ended questions) while being faithful (e.g., grounding responses in the given context)... we evaluate on extractive QA, abstractive QA and summarization datasets.

answer_2.quote: We adopt widely adopted approaches... Faithfulness Score... span coverage score... SummaC-ZeroShot... Task Performance... Exact Match (EM) for extractive QA... ROUGE-L for abstractive QA and summarization.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the commonly used evaluation paradigm proposed by LLM-as-a-Judge, and zero-shot prompt GPT-4 to provide a rating... External judges are offline evaluators... we also use ChatGPT as a weaker judge.
